checks.title: libvirtd service is active
checks.rationale: libvirtd is the management API daemon for KVM.

checks.title: qemu-kvm package is installed
checks.command: command -v qemu-system-x86_64 >/dev/null && echo present || echo missing
checks.rationale: Inventory sanity check that the KVM userspace exists.

checks.title: virt-host-validate reports KVM accelerated virtualization is supported
checks.command: virt-host-validate qemu 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/Checking for hardware virtualization/ {print $2; exit}' | xargs
checks.rationale: Hardware virt extensions enable KVM acceleration; absent CPU support, VMs fall back to emulation.
checks.remediation: Enable VT-x/AMD-V in firmware; verify with 'egrep "vmx|svm" /proc/cpuinfo'.

checks.title: IOMMU is enabled at kernel level
checks.rationale: IOMMU isolates device DMA between guest VMs - required for safe PCI passthrough.
checks.remediation: Add 'intel_iommu=on' or 'amd_iommu=on' to GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX, then update-grub and reboot.

checks.title: AppArmor (or SELinux) is enforcing for libvirt
checks.rationale: AppArmor/SELinux confines QEMU processes, limiting blast radius of a guest escape.
checks.remediation: Install apparmor + libvirt-daemon-system; ensure /etc/apparmor.d/abstractions/libvirt-qemu is enforced.

checks.title: Inventory total VMs (informational)
checks.command: virsh list --all 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>2 && NF>0 {n++} END {print n+0}'
checks.rationale: Inventory baseline of all defined libvirt domains (running + stopped).

checks.title: No libvirt VMs running as the root user
checks.rationale: qemu-system processes should run as the unprivileged 'libvirt-qemu' / 'qemu' user to limit guest-escape impact.
checks.remediation: Configure /etc/libvirt/qemu.conf with user = "libvirt-qemu" and group = "kvm", then restart libvirtd.

checks.title: Default libvirt network is NAT (not bridged to physical LAN)
checks.command: virsh net-dumpxml default 2>/dev/null | awk -F'[<>]' '/<forward/ {for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i~/mode=/) print $i}' | head -1
checks.rationale: A NAT default network prevents VM east-west exposure on the host's physical network.
checks.remediation: Edit the default network XML to use forward mode='nat' or 'route'.

checks.title: Manual: review SSH key-only authentication on the hypervisor
checks.audit: Inspect /etc/ssh/sshd_config for 'PasswordAuthentication no' and 'PubkeyAuthentication yes'. Confirm only approved keys are in authorized_keys for the management user.
checks.rationale: Disabling password auth on the KVM hypervisor blocks credential brute-force.
checks.remediation: Set 'PasswordAuthentication no' in sshd_config and reload sshd.

checks.title: Manual: review virsh secret storage for encrypted disks / Ceph keys
checks.audit: Run 'virsh secret-list'. Confirm encryption / Ceph / iSCSI secrets are present and recently rotated.
checks.rationale: Secrets used for storage encryption and remote pools must be managed and rotated.
checks.remediation: Rotate secrets per policy with 'virsh secret-set-value'.
